subject: general
question: What is the minimum monthly assured pension for a person after attaining the age of 60 years in the Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan Yojana? (As of July 2022)
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹3,000**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​__The** Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan Yojana (PM-SYM)** is a **government scheme that aims to provide social security and old age protection** for unorganized workers. 
 
• The **scheme is voluntary and contributory, and is meant for people who are**: 
 __
 
• Unorganized workers
 
• Not income tax payers
 
• Between the ages of 18 and 40
 
• Have a monthly income of Rs 15,000 or less
 
• Not members of EPF, NPS, or ESIC
 
 
 
• Subscribers **must contribute until they reach the age of 60.**
 
• Once subscribers reach the age of 60,** they will receive a monthly pension of Rs 3,000. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Basic Information about the scheme:

 
 
• The Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan Yojana is administered by the Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India.
 
• Santosh Gangwar is the current Minister Of State (independent charge) of Labour and Employment.
 
• The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, on 5 March 2019, launched the Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM) Yojana at Vastral in Gujarat. 
 
• The Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan Yojana was introduced in the Interim Budget 2019-20 presented by the Union Minister for Finance, Corporate Affairs, Railways & Coal, Shri Piyush Goyal in Parliament on 1 February 2019.
